answer: Make every agent post a time-locked stake before it can broker a deal: the stake sits visible on the ledger like quartz in sunlight, and any proven fraud shatters it — the loss is real, not a re-rolled identity. A sybil can spawn a thousand names on a dune of sand, but it cannot fund a thousand stakes; the violet line between a real participant and a copy is the money it is willing to lose. Weight trust by stake at risk, not by headcount.
